book.title: Gelindo Kunlade Huaisan Ji 2 Hui Xin

content: Mai zemin jieredu zhanfanyi chei widaghase Hudai hhense ireku gie matande winekui matan mejiene. Kunni khaghala giesan pusho, asiman jieredu chanqiku gie wo.
Matan ene zhanfande shonholozhi asimanse iresan gieghala jien musiku mutun arunzhakui panjizho.
Qingie musise hulan muchughun ulie gholune.
Matan ene zhanfande gunduni beiliezhi shonholokushi teine ese giezho, musine giezho. Ingiezhi ene fuguku beyei amin yenji boughane.
Ene mujide oluzhi matai nanpeilasanshi Huda wo. Hhe matande Shenlinni yajin danlaghazhi ogiwo.
Ingiese, matan beyede bikude Ezhanse gholo bikui mejienema, matande chan fugie danzi wine.
Matan yan giese chanlakughala ese giezho, xianxin giekughala giezho.
Matande fugie danzi wine. Beyese likai giezhi Ezhanghala hhantu souku genjia duran wine.
Ingiese matan beyedeye olune beyese likai gieye olune matanyi mujishi hhei bayasughane.
Matan man bixi Mexihani shenpantai melie xienjizhi khizheghadene zhao jien kun giesan gouni, doghunni mutun kharulune.
Kunlai Hudaghala Goudaghaku Renwu
Ezhanshi indan zunjikui bijien mejiese kunlade sughazhi kieliene. Huda bijienyi mejiene, bi xiwon giese taye zhughedene bijienyi mejie.
Bijien pse tande goyalane jieshao ese giezho, bijienyi kuaiku jihuini tande ogine giezho. Ingiese hhezighan zhughei ulie uzhedene mienzii uzhezhi kuaisan kunlai melie kieliekui wine.
Bijien fenjiulise Hudade oluzho, zhenchanshi tande oluzho.
Ingiekushi Mexihani oreku bijienyi biizho. Nie kun soyuji kunlade oluzhi duya ijiese soyuji kunla duya ijiesanyi bijien mejiene.
Mexiha soyuji kunlade oluzhi duya ijiekushi amitu kunla pse goyadene oluzhi ulie amiturazhi hhelade oluzhi duya ijiedene aminne olusan Ezhande oluzhi amituraghane giezho.
Ingiese enedu khuinase matan kienniliuzhe kunni uzhedanghala ulie uzhene. Eqighandei Mexihaniye kunni uzhedanghala uzhewoma, ede pse qingiezhi ulie uzhene.
Kien Mexihai miende bise hheshi shini giesan kun wo, khuichennila daozhi man shinii gholuwo.
Enelashi man Hudase iresan wo. Hhe Ersa Mexihai tungo giezhi matanyi goyarene goudaghazhi pse kun Hudaghala goudaghaku renwuni matande ogiwo.
Eneshijiu Huda duyai kunlai zuini ese asadene Mexihai tungo giezhi goyarene goudaghazho. Pse goudaghaku daolini matande jiuizhi ogiwo.
Ingiese matan Mexihai daibio giezho. Huda matai tungo giezhi kunlade sidaghazhi kieliezho. Matan Mexihai oronde ta Hudare gouda giezhi tai xiahua gieye.
Huda hhe zui wituni matande oluzhi zuitu gholughakushi matanyi hhei sudoro Hudai gouni gholughane giezho.
